newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria KTM shares to cost 590 ATS - lead.
newsitem.headline: Austria KTM shares to cost 590 ATS - lead.

text.p: Ordinary shares in Austria's lone motorcycle manufacturer KTM Motorradholding AG will cost 590 schillings apiece in an initial public offering, at the top end of the 500-600 schillings price band, the co-lead manager said.
The subscription period for up to 920,000 shares, which was due to run from November 22 to December 5, had already closed, a spokesman for Creditanstalt-Bankverein told Reuters.
He did not say whether KTM would exercise a green-shoe option for 120,000 additional shares on top of the basic offer of 800,000 shares.
KTM shares will begin trading on the Vienna stock exchange on December 12.
The firm, which specialises in off-road motorcycles, narrowly avoided insolvency in 1991. It has said proceeds from the share offer will go towards financing expansion and developing new products.
